title: Xcelsior Control Plane
description: Current workload, worker health, billing evidence, durable delivery, database freshness, recovery proof and GPU/host capacity. Idle workload is valid; missing observations remain NO DATA.

panels.title: API reachable
panels.description: API metrics endpoint reachability. Database freshness is shown separately below.

panels.title: Services
panels.description: Fresh scheduler, reconciler, outbox and maintenance identities. Inspect heartbeat age for a missing service.

panels.title: Ready hosts
panels.description: Admitted hosts with current observations that can accept a placement.

panels.title: Attempts
panels.description: Durable active execution attempts; zero is normal when the site is idle.

panels.title: Warnings
panels.description: Native Prometheus warning instances. Healthy Prometheus supplies an idle zero when no alert instances exist; missing scrape data remains unknown.

panels.title: Platform dependency reachability
panels.description: One means the scrape/probe succeeds, zero means it fails, and missing data remains NO DATA. Scrape reachability does not prove inference quality.

panels.title: Billing exceptions
panels.description: Repairs remain report_only. Historical evidence gaps stay visible; do not invent charges to clear a warning.

panels.title: Database signals age
panels.description: Age of the last successful database snapshot. Check signal availability below if fresh data stops.

panels.title: Last successful backup
panels.description: Age of the most recent verified native backup on the application cluster.

panels.title: Last successful restore drill
panels.description: Age of the last successful disposable restore and invariant drill; distinct from creating a backup.

panels.title: Current native alerts
panels.description: Current native Prometheus alerts. An empty list is expected when no alerts are firing. Inspect warnings before taking action; repairs remain report_only.
